summary: Butler County lookout on Lone Hill: a 100-foot steel tower erected in 1951, per one source. No source found describes the site today.

events.note: 100-foot steel tower erected; the page gives no other construction details

evidence.supports: Butler County listing under the Missouri Conservation Commission, survey location 24N-5E-18
evidence.quote: Missouri Lookouts - Butler County - Missouri Conservation Commission - 24N-5E-18

evidence.supports: 1951: 100-foot steel tower erected at Lone Hill

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. One source, which gives a header and a single line for 1951. The story is about 50 words, below the 120-word floor, because the source offers nothing else and padding would invent detail. Status, staffing, access and visit are unknown, and no source describes the site. height_m 30.5 is the source's 100 feet converted, and matches the brief. Do not conflate with us-mo-lone-hill-2 (Franklin County, lat 38.22981, lon -91.0687; the merge report ties it to the Central US Lookouts record lone-hill1), or with a Lone Hill Lookout Tower near Patterson/Fairdealing in Wayne County (a TopoZone page in the cache). Web search was not available in this run, so a fresh search for the Butler County tower may find more.
